conditions.transport: LAN direct to isolated local KonomiTV
conditions.playback: recorded MPEG-2 TS Original, YADIF double-rate, true fullscreen
conditions.pressureInjection: for 2 seconds, retain rVFC input but call presentation on every other rAF
conditions.tabRule: one page during measurement; page closed after every run

interpretation.purpose: Separate ordinary rAF phase jitter, sustained presentation shortage, capacity retirement, and clock-divergence reset.
interpretation.droppedVideoFramesCaveat: Chrome droppedVideoFrames increased while rVFC presentedFrames had no gaps; it is not counted as a visible-frame loss without corroboration.

excludedRuns.reason: The user interacted with the device during the run.
video.paused was true, so zero rVFC and draw counts did not measure occlusion or scheduler behavior.

conclusions.normalOneFieldMinimalFifo: 59.91-60.03 canvas fps with no late increments in all three runs.
conclusions.normalTwoStage: 59.88-60.04 canvas fps with no late increments in all three runs.
conclusions.normalLegacyMulti: 59.98-60.00 canvas fps with no late increments in all three runs; a one-field-per-rAF benefit was not established under this condition.
conclusions.throttledMinimalFifo: 58-60 fields retired individually, zero full resets, and final measured lateness 4.4-27.6 ms.
conclusions.throttledFullReset: 57-60 fields removed across 14-15 full resets, with transient measured lateness 66.5-83.3 ms.
conclusions.pullRequestBoundary: Capacity FIFO versus clock-divergence reset is supported as a correctness change. One-field presentation and initial lead remain separate candidates pending stronger natural-load evidence.
